GENERATE BURST KL-10-S — Run C-9 P4, M3 consistency fix (Matt: helm, NE tabard pattern, S stance). task_id "KL-10-S".

Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 (the knight, painted in the hand of a c. 1530 Flemish manuscript, background flat green). Change ONLY his LEGS and FEET: he is standing in a stride (one leg forward, one foot pointing down the screen). Put him in the same calm REST STANCE as IMAGE 2: both feet planted on the ground about shoulder-width apart, knees nearly straight, weight even, toes pointing toward the viewer and slightly outward; the pollaxe butt still resting on the ground beside his right foot.
Keep EVERYTHING ELSE exactly as it is: his helm, torso, arms, tabard and heraldry, the pollaxe in his right hand, his direction (facing the viewer), size and framing, flat pure #00ff00 background. Paint in EXACTLY the same hand (line, red-brown hatching, uneven washes, gouache-like steel). For this step the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY THE IMAGES: do not re-render or restyle.

One image_gen EDIT call. ONE retry only if he is still in a stride, anything above the waist changed, or the background is not flat green — name the reason. Copy the output to out/KL-10-S.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "KL-10-S"; images = the file with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — THE IMAGE TO EDIT (facing the viewer; fix only the legs)
IMAGE 2 — the same knight's REST STANCE, lower-right diagonal (legs and feet reference)
